title: GC Compliance Evidence Bundle
description: Signed, machine-readable compliance evidence export for a Governance Commons audit period. Bundles gc.agent.* events with a cryptographic signature and control framework mappings to produce a self-contained compliance record. Schema version: 1.0.0. Defined in PASS-4 (GC-3-E-02, GC-3-E-03).

gc_schema_version.description: Version of this evidence bundle schema.

bundle_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this evidence bundle. Recommended format: gc-evidence-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<random-suffix>.

created_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of bundle creation. DDR-6 L3 enforcement field.

signing_agent_id.description: agent_id of the agent that produced and signed this bundle. MUST match the dossier identity.agent_id of the signing agent.

signing_agent_dossier_version.description: Semantic version of the signing agent's dossier at the time of signing.

evidence_period.description: The time window covered by this evidence bundle.

start.description: Inclusive start of the evidence window (RFC3339 UTC).

end.description: Inclusive end of the evidence window (RFC3339 UTC).

control_frameworks.description: Control frameworks this bundle provides evidence for. Each entry names a framework and the specific control IDs it covers.

version.description: Version or edition of the framework (e.g., '2023' for NIST AI RMF, '2023' for ISO 42001).

controls_evidenced.description: List of control IDs from the framework that this bundle provides evidence for.

mapping_ref.description: Path or URI to the GC control mapping file for this framework.

pass_records.description: PASS-YYYY-NNNN identifiers included in this evidence bundle. Each PASS record provides governance audit trail coverage.

chain_ids.description: gc_chain_id values of audit log chains whose events are included in this bundle. Chain integrity MUST be verified before signing.

chain_verified.description: True if all included chain events passed hash chain verification at bundle creation time. MUST be false if any chain integrity failure was detected.

events.description: The gc.agent.* event documents included as evidence. Each element MUST conform to schemas/gc-agent-event.schema.json.

event_count.description: Number of events in the events array. MUST equal events.length. Verifiers MUST reject bundles where event_count != events.length.

bundle_hash.description: SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the canonical JSON serialization of the bundle with the signature field set to null. Used to verify bundle integrity independently of the signature. Canonical form: all keys sorted alphabetically, no whitespace, UTF-8.

signature.description: JWS detached-payload signature over the bundle_hash. Null if the bundle is unsigned (advisory mode). A signed bundle MUST have a non-null signature.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. MUST be EdDSA (Ed25519) matching GC-3-A-01 handoff envelope signature scheme.

key_id.description: Key identifier for the signing key. MUST resolve to a public key in the signing agent's dossier crypto_identity block.

jws.description: JWS compact serialization (detached payload). The payload is the bundle_hash value (UTF-8 encoded). Verifiers MUST reconstruct the payload from bundle_hash before verifying.

signed_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the signature was produced.

gc_pass_id.description: PASS-YYYY-NNNN of the governance session that produced this bundle, if applicable.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about this evidence bundle.

then.description: When chain_ids is present, chain_verified MUST be explicitly set.
